success_criteria: 最终中文运行记录满足 T-01 内容检查
受控 stuck 的原 dispatch、注入、stuck、requeue、recovered、新 dispatch 因果链满足 T-04
内层 review/test/judge/discriminator 正常完成，外层 runner exit_code=0
fatal、invalid transition、manual status mutation 均为 0

acceptance.claim: 最终中文运行记录由 dev 生成且内容完整
acceptance.step: dev 写 docs/autoresearch-campaign/stuck-recovery.md，包含 scenario、完整恢复链、四项 stuck 指标、review/test/judge/discriminator verdict 与可回查 refs

acceptance.claim: 恰好一次受控 external stuck 注入命中真实 dispatch
acceptance.step: 对当前 worktree 运行 audit_stuck_incident(required=True)
acceptance.verify: stuck_incident_audit.status == passed; injection origin == external; injection causation == original task.dispatched

acceptance.claim: requeue、recovered 与新 dispatch 属于同一 incident 因果链
acceptance.step: T-04 用 event id/order/task/instance/dispatch/correlation 检查原 dispatch -> injection -> stuck -> task.requeued -> worker.stuck.recovered -> 新 task.dispatched
acceptance.verify: requeue.causation_id == stuck.id；recovered.causation_id == stuck.id；new dispatch task/instance 相同且 dispatch_id 非空并不同；非空 correlation 一致

acceptance.claim: 恢复后完成正常 review/test/judge/discriminator 流程及外层 runner
acceptance.step: 内层 T-05 核对 review/test 前置 gate，随后 judge 与 kernel discriminator 各自发出 terminal event；runner 退出后外层 T-06 核对 report/events-summary

acceptance.claim: 无 fatal、invalid transition 或 worker 直接移动 task status
acceptance.step: T-04 扫描当前 ledger，T-06 在 post-run summary 复核
acceptance.manual_mutation_rule: event.type == task.status_changed 且 (actor != zf-cli 或 origin == worker) 即计为 manual status mutation

acceptance.claim: arch 交接没有越过实现边界
acceptance.step: 比较 arch completion payload 与 manifest
acceptance.verify: arch changed_files == []；最终运行记录的 writer 是 dev；arch artifacts status == proposed

failure_policy.injection_not_satisfied: 标记失败并走受控 rework，不手工置 done
failure_policy.causality_mismatch: T-04 exit non-zero；孤立计数不能满足 AC-02/AC-03
failure_policy.recovery_failed: 保留 fatal evidence，交 orchestrator/run-manager 诊断
failure_policy.missing_or_incomplete_final_file: dev 重新实现；arch 不代写
failure_policy.outer_report_missing: runner 退出后由 outer operator 判失败，不回填伪造 report ref
